canonical_narrative.P: Sum of event log point intensities; log-score unit nats.
canonical_narrative.Q: Sum of event log regional ground intensities; nats.
canonical_narrative.E: Positive full-domain integrated intensity (exposure); expected-count dimension, enters log score with negative sign.
canonical_narrative.M: Marginal magnitude-mark log score, included once; common contrast cancels.
canonical_narrative.ell_score: Joint log score ell = P + C + M = P - E + M. The symbol ell_score here must not be confused with the LI spatial range ell_km.
canonical_narrative.differences: Delta always candidate minus named reference. Delta C = -Delta E; delta joint = delta P + delta C + delta M.

source_specific_raw_fields.definition: Despite its raw key E, this inherited LI field is the event point-logsum difference, NOT positive integrated exposure.
Signed contribution from negative integrated intensity.
Positive integrated-intensity difference. Its contribution to timing and joint differences is NEGATIVE this stored value.
source_specific_raw_fields.unit: exposure (same numerical term enters nat score with minus sign)

source_specific_raw_fields.definition: Positive integrated-intensity difference; compensator_contribution is its negative.
Positive integrated-intensity difference; signed_negative_C is its negative. In this JMA raw source, positive_C denotes positive integrated intensity.

source_specific_raw_fields.canonical: Delta E in contrast rows; E in arm rows
source_specific_raw_fields.definition: Positive integrated intensity or its candidate-minus-reference difference; enters timing/joint with minus sign.

preservation: All raw scalar keys and values remain byte-exact in releasable_results.json. This dictionary disambiguates notation only. No score, comparison, denominator or figure is changed.
empirical_interpretation: The LI range ell and memory psi are unidentifiable at exact eta=0; canonical 30 km/7 days are conventions, not fitted physical scales. EP calibration was not tested by the completed OC calibration exercise.
